mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals weakening labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a UNRATE rise > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a sustained GDPC1 decline.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a INDPRO increase > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals an inflationary pressure not countered by monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced real returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with low interest rates
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances following the described trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and economic growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 300,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following the described trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% within a month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate revenues and earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a RSAFS increase > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% in a month and industrial production (INDPRO) simultaneously declines by more than 1%, it signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate profits.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases > 10% and INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following the described trigger.
